Care is also re- quired with calcium channel blockers, which may in- crease the risk of congestive heart failure if given to- gether, and nisoldipine in particular is considered contra-indicated. Antimicrobial Action Itraconazole is a triazole antifungal drug that in sensi- tive fungi inhibits cytochrome P450-dependent en- zymes resulting in impairment of ergosterol synthesis in fungal cell membranes. It has a slightly wider spec- trum of activity than ketoconazole.
